1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than __1500 Da__ and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent __metal__ cation crosslinker.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium, or calcium ions, wherein said cations __are provided in a concentration lower than that which would cause precipitation of the polyelectrolyte complex__.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprises a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about __100 to 800 nm__ in diameter.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than __800 nm__.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent __metal__ cation.

14) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle for delivery of an oil and gas chemical to a reservoir, said composition comprising a polyethylenimine of less than __1500 Da__ and a polyanion intimately associated with an oil and gas field chemical to form a polyelectrolyte complex, said complex having an average particle size of less than one micron.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim __1__; b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid. 

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, __wherein at least one of the polymers is functionalized for enhanced crosslinking__. 

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, __wherein the fluid is selected from the group consisting of brine, seawater, and fresh water__.
